'''Operation Raging Dawn''' was a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] operation carried out early in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It saw the Empire [[Battle of Aeten II|defend]] the sabotaged [[Kilran's Lance]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Aeten system/Legends|Aeten system]], and [[Battle of Vondoru|destroy]] the ''[[Intercessor]]'' above [[Vondoru]].
